snippet.title: Gravebound Early Access Reveal. Enter the Wastelands September 22nd.
snippet.description:
🔴 Wishlist Gravebound on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613050/Gravebound/

🔥 Want to win a free key? Join our Discord  https://discord.gg/fzNrP79jXh

Gravebound is a 6 player co op PvE extraction shooter where every run is about getting stronger, finding better gear, and making it out alive.

Fight through a post apocalyptic world overrun by killer appliances, take on bosses, level your weapons, build around powerful relics, and push into harder difficulties for better loot.

Early Access September 22, 2026.
#Gravebound #ExtractionShooter #CoopGames #IndieGames
